Create an independently invented, visibly testable complex photographic scenario using the attached adult appearance reference, with the randomized variation seed interpreted as a wind-driven coastal salvage operation.

A photorealistic scene of an unmistakably adult woman with a softly tapered oval face, wide-set almond-shaped dark eyes, a long lower face and narrow jaw, a centered slightly peaked hairline, and long dark wavy hair in a wind-driven coastal salvage operation. On a storm-battered tidal platform, she braces a weathered orange salvage tarp with one boot and hauls a salt-stiffened rope, lifting a barnacle-covered brass ship's bell and tangled blue glass floats from a half-flooded skiff. Her hair, torn sailcloth, loose chart sheets, and red survey ribbons stream toward the same offshore direction. Wet rope and a clipped carabiner occupy the near plane; the woman, bell, and listing skiff form the middle plane; a leaning beacon, black sea stacks, and circling gulls establish the far plane. Reflective rock pools, white foam channels, and dark cliff recesses create clear depth and clearly separable and verifiable visual relationships.
